Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Charging wedge silhouette; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 legs catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 legs splay and bend to catch weight; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied leg support; not repeated standing duplicates. Keep FOUR animal feet and natural creature anatomy, no rearing, no human arms. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description. CORRECTION: The previous sheet was rejected as nearly static. Make the head and shoulder mass jerk BACK by one head length for the flinch. For heavy stagger bend the forelegs deeply, twist the entire shoulder mass backward 25 degrees and splay the feet to catch lost balance; then rise and recover. Four feet, rear anatomy retained, head toward upper right. Must be a visibly struggling creature, not standing duplicates or walking. Match exact faceted GREY stone slab palette and blue seams of Reference-2, not smooth green cartoon hide. Ten small complete separate poses.
